4689114.note: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

2972515.note: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game versus Green Bay but will serve as the emergency quarterback.

3052587.note: Mayfield is dealing with a dislocated right thumb and will have an MRI on the injury, head coach Todd Bowles relayed after Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

5344782.note: Strand (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Packers.
